description: This file defines a PHP trait 'ProviderRedirectTrait' that provides redirect handling capabilities for OAuth2 client providers, including methods to follow redirects, get and set redirect limits, and determine redirect responses.

methods.name: followRequestRedirects
methods.description: Follows redirects by sending the request and checking for redirect responses, up to the redirect limit.

methods.name: getHttpClient
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the HTTP client instance.

methods.name: isRedirect
methods.description: Determines if a response is a redirect based on its status code and headers.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Sends a request and returns the response, handling redirects and exceptions.

methods.name: setRedirectLimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of redirects to follow, with validation.
